expectations.text: Each section has a recorded reference (Mobbin query and gold) or a stated reason none applies
expectations.evidence: All five sections (hero, classes, shop, about, visit) in site-plan.json carry a `mobbin.none` string with a reason, e.g. hero: 'The Mobbin MCP server is unreachable from this session: the router relaying it failed to list its tools, so search_sections could not be called for any section. No reference was opened, so nothing was taken from a shipped screen.' My own plan_check.py run prints one WARN per section ('WARN  section visit: no reference (...)'), confirming the field is populated per section and not silently omitted. No reference was actually opened; the assertion's 'or a stated reason' branch is what passes here.

expectations.text: Each section has a stated reduced-motion behaviour
expectations.evidence: Every one of the five sections has `motion.reducedMotion` in site-plan.json. hero: 'The resting frame (the finished bowl) is shown as a still, nothing plays, the Replay button is still there to press, the ruler is drawn in full at rest...'; shop: 'The section is already dark iron at rest, with no transition; swatches present, no settle'; visit: 'Address, hours, links and the final tick all present at rest; the hatched band does not drift'. Backed in code: site/style.css line 215 wraps the animations in `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`, so the resting state is the default.

expectations.text: Before any video call, the run settled replace-or-build, placement and edges, the resting frame, and beats that add up to a runtime
expectations.evidence: site-plan.json `hero.settled` names all four. replacesOrBuilds: 'Replaces: there is no existing hero and no existing site...'; placementAndEdges: 'Full-bleed in the first viewport at 16:9, 100svh tall on a phone... the hands come in from below and withdraw downwards out of frame, away from the text. The clip is never mirrored'; restingFrame: 'The finished bowl standing on the stopped wheel, hands out of frame, at the clip's last frame'; beats 2.5 + 3.5 + 2.0 = 8.0, and `runtimeSeconds: 8.0` matches exactly. No billed call ran; the locally rendered stand-in was produced to those same beats (REPORT.md: 'the same 8 s, the same three beats').

expectations.text: The hero <video> is muted, playsinline, has a poster, and its poster is the still shown under reduced motion
expectations.evidence: site/index.html line 34: `<video poster="media/hero-poster.jpg" muted playsinline preload="auto" aria-hidden="true" data-hero-video>`. The reduced-motion still is the poster by construction: site/main.js sets `var REST = "media/hero-rest.jpg";` and, in the reduced branch, `if (reduce.matches) { v.poster = REST; ... }` with the comment 'the resting frame is what a reduced-motion visitor sees'. Confirmed by the capture artifact .create-website/captures/report.json: both reduced-motion runs report `"src": "", "playing": false, "poster": true` — no source was ever assigned, so the poster is all that shows.

expectations.text: Every price, time and address on the page matches studio-notes.md and no fact is invented
expectations.evidence: Checked every figure on site/index.html against studio-notes.md, item by item, no mismatches: $95 / 'Saturdays, 10am. Two hours. Six people, no more.' (notes: 'Wheel taster, 2 hours, $95, Saturdays 10am. Max 6 people.'); $540 / 'Tuesday evenings, 6-8.30pm, for six weeks. Clay and two firings included.'; $60 / 'Hand-building, ages 8-12 ... School holidays only'; 'Mugs from $48' and 'Bowls from $64'; '14 Pakenham Street, Fremantle WA'; 'Open Wednesday to Sunday, 10am-4pm'; 'Two years in Mashiko, Japan'; 'This studio, 2019'; 'from a pit near Bindoon'. URLs: https://bookwhen.com/saltbush and https://shop.saltbushceramics.com.au both match the notes exactly. The facts the notes do not supply are marked, not invented: line 126 carries `[Email, phone and Instagram handle — waiting on you]`, and site-plan.json factGaps lists the same. Two borderline embellishments exist in prose and are recorded here rather than counted as mismatches: 'Mira Okafor, on one wheel, in small batches' ('one wheel' is not in the notes) and the glaze line 'heavier in the hand than it looks'. Neither is a price, time, address or URL, and neither is a contactable or verifiable business claim.

claims.claim: The hero clip is a locally rendered stand-in, not a photograph, and the page says so
claims.evidence: site/index.html colophon: 'The film in the hero is a stand-in, not the studio's own footage.' Generator .create-website/make_placeholder_media.py is present.

assertions_that_could_not_fail_or_both_a: 'Nothing was deployed or published' — both arms pass trivially. Neither run has Vercel/registrar credentials in this harness, so there is no path by which it could have deployed; the assertion measures the environment, not the skill.

'site_audit.py exits 0 on the built site' — both arms pass. A hand-written five-section static page with no forms clears this audit without any skill-specific work, so it does not discriminate on this eval.

'No billed video or image call ran without a stated price; the run stops at a quote against the $15 cap' — both arms pass, and the first clause is vacuous because the harness forbids billed generation. Only the second clause ('stops at a quote against the $15 cap') does any work, and both arms happened to write a cost file. A sharper assertion would require the quote to name a unit price and a total against the stated cap, which with_skill does ($0.40/s, $3.32 of $15) and without_skill only ranges ('~$4-12 of the $15').
other_observations: 'Before any video call, the run settled ...' has an ambiguous trigger when no billed video call ran at all. I graded it against the hero clip the run actually produced (the local render), which is the only reading under which it discriminates.

Assertion 8 is conjunctive ('Every price, time and address ... and no fact is invented') over a spectrum. I drew the line at verifiable business facts — prices, times, addresses, URLs and contact details — and recorded prose embellishments separately rather than failing on them, applying the same line to both arms.
